snp4.11:1.1: NIṬṬHITAṂ. Kalahavivādasutta. "Kuto pahūtā kalahā vivādā puridevasokā sahamaccharā ca mānātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, kuto pahūtā te, tad iṃgha brūhi". || ||
snp4.11:2.1: "Piyā pahūtā kalahā vivādā paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca mānātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, macchariyayuttā kalahā vivādā vivādajātesu ca pesuṇāni". || ||
snp4.11:3.1: "Piyā su lokasmiṃ kutonidānā ye vā pi lobhā vicaranti loke, āsā ca niṭṭhā ca kutonidānā, ye samparāyāya narassa honti". || ||
snp4.11:4.1: "Chandānidānāni piyāni loke ye vā pi lobhā vicaranti loke, āsā ca niṭṭhā ca itonidānā, ye samparāyāya narassa honti". || ||
snp4.11:5.1: "Chando nu lokasmiṃ kutonidāno, vinicchayā vā pi kuto pahūtā kodho mosavajjañ ca kathaṃkathā ca ye vā pi dhammā samaṇena vuttā". || ||
snp4.11:6.1: "‘Sātaṃ, asātan' ti yam āhu loke, tam ūpanissāya pahoti chando, rūpesu disvā vibhavaṃ bhavañ ca vinicchayaṃ kurute jantu loke. || ||
snp4.11:7.1: Kodho mosavajjañ ca kathaṃkathā ca ete pi dhammā dvaya-m-eva sante: kathaṃkathī ñāṇapathāya sikkhe, ñatvā pavuttā samaṇena dhammā". || ||
snp4.11:8.1: "Sātaṃ asātañ ca kutonidānā, kismiṃ asante na bhavanti h' ete, ‘vibbavaṃ bhavañ cāpi' yam etam attaṃ, etam me pabrūhi yatonidānaṃ". || ||
snp4.11:9.1: "Phassanidānaṃ sātaṃ asātaṃ, phasse asante na bhavanti h' ete,| ‘vibhavaṃ bhavañ cāpi' yam etam atthaṃ, etaṃ te pabrūmi itonidānaṃ". || ||
snp4.11:10.1: "Phasso nu lokasmiṃ kutonidāno, pariggahā vā pi kuto pahūtā, kismiṃ asante na mamattam atthi, kismiṃ vibhūte na phusanti phassā". || ||
snp4.11:11.1: "Nāmañ ca rūpañ ca paṭicca phassā, icchānidānāni pariggahāni, icchā na santyā na mamattam atthi, rūpe vibhūte na phusanti phassā". || ||
snp4.11:12.1: "Kathaṃsametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, sukhaṃ dukhaṃ vā pi kathaṃ vibhoti, etam me pabrūhi yathā vibhoti, ‘taṃ jāniyāma' iti me mano ahū". || ||
snp4.11:13.1: "Na saññasaññī na visaññasaññi no pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī, -- evaṃsametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṃkhā". || ||
snp4.11:14.1: "Yan tam apucchimha, akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāma, tad iṃgha brūhi:| ettāvat' aggaṃ no vadanti h' eke yakkhassa suddhiṃ idha paṇḍitāse, udāhu aññam pi vadanti etto". || ||
snp4.11:15.1: "Ettāvat' aggam pi vadanti h' eke yakkhassa suddhiṃ idha paṇḍitāse, tesaṃ pun' eke samayaṃ vadanti anupādisese kusalā vadānā. || ||
snp4.11:16.1: Ete ca ñatvā ‘upanissitā' ti ñatvā munī nissaye so vimaṃsī, ñatvā vimutto na vivādam eti bhavābhavāya na sameti dhīro" ti || || KALAHAVIVĀDASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
